# Relaxed QWERTY

> A complete guided course in making your hands more at home with the keyboard. Accuracy first. Time to settle. Something small to keep along the way.

Not to be confused with: a keyboard layout, a keyboard remapper, Dvorak or Colemak.

## Documentation

### Your course

What is RQWERTY?

RQWERTY is a free, guided touch-typing course on a standard QWERTY keyboard. Its 36 lessons cover letters, capitals, punctuation, numbers and longer mixed passages, with four optional code lessons.

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/what-it-is/

### The method

What makes Relaxed QWERTY different?

Relaxed QWERTY keeps the usual QWERTY layout and stable finger assignments, while allowing the hands to move. Z uses the left ring finger, X the left middle, C the left index and B the right index.

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/the-method/

### How you advance

How do I finish a lesson?

Each lesson has a short, visible sequence of exercises. Every accuracy pass moves you forward; the last exercise completes the lesson. Chapter passages require 97% accuracy. Speed is never a gate.

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/progress/

### Things to keep

How do keepsakes work?

Each chapter gives you one permanent illustrated keepsake. It remembers a capability you practised and opens that chapter’s passage for replay.

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/keepsakes/

### Your progress

Where is my progress saved?

Relaxed QWERTY stores progress in this browser, or your account when signed in. An account is free and optional; it syncs progress across devices.

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/your-data/

### Made with intention

Who makes RQWERTY?

RQWERTY is made by Strange Systems, the studio behind CropASAP and No Ceremony.

https://keygrove-phi.vercel.app/docs/who-makes-this/
